provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS DAST cumulative gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: An image response has no charset parameter to declare, so the charset-less rule must stay silent (the old check reported every binary response).

groundTruth.rationale: image/png is a binary media type; a charset parameter is neither defined nor meaningful for it. Reporting it would be a false positive caused by an over-broad rule.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live asset fetch.
Only the media-type scoping is proven here; the rule says nothing about the image bytes.
